scope: Isolated local SIDE B case and HTML storefront. No live Shopify or device verification.

checks.name: Responsive layout, loaded lazy images, local links and targets
checks.detail: Case and demo at 1440×1000, 320×740, 390×844, 768×1024 and 568×320; no horizontal overflow or broken local resources. Non-dialog buttons/inputs/selects are at least 44px high.

checks.name: Meaningful genre filtering
checks.detail: Correct record shown for each genre; selected state and live record count; hidden cards have no rendered/focusable controls.

checks.name: Empty bag and Escape
checks.detail: Empty explanation, zero subtotal, native modal dismissal and opener focus restoration.

checks.name: Format validation, quantity validation and edition separation
checks.detail: Unselected format and quantities blank/0/negative/fractional/10 rejected; 2 LPs at £28 plus 1 art edition at £36 produce 3 items and £92.00 across two distinct lines.

checks.name: Bag updates, persistence and removal
checks.detail: Invalid update retains £92; valid update yields £120 and keeps field focus; reload preserves bag; removing editions reaches £84 then empty £0 with feedback inside bag dialog.

checks.name: Per-edition maximum and keyboard restoration
checks.detail: Duplicate adds cannot exceed 9 of the same edition. Escape restores the record opener. Shift+Tab/Tab wrap within the modal.

checks.name: Malformed storage recovery
checks.detail: Invalid JSON, unknown product, duplicate edition and fractional saved quantity reset to an empty bag with an explicit notice, including inside the active bag dialog.

checks.name: Unavailable storage fallback
checks.detail: SecurityError on read and QuotaExceededError on write retain an in-memory bag; 2 Soft Static art editions total £68; honest visit-only messaging inside active dialogs.

checks.name: Touch and reduced motion
checks.detail: Emulated mobile touch opens product, changes detail immediately and adds record; no running animations. No physical device is claimed.

checks.name: Colour pairings
checks.detail: Declared text and cover pairings exceed 4.5:1; focus pairings exceed 3:1. This is scoped evidence, not a WCAG conformance claim.

checks.name: JavaScript and console errors
checks.detail: No pageerror or console error across exercised local pages and failure fixtures.
